descriptions.en: Optional aspect prefix with trailing space; empty string when unused
descriptions.zh-CN: 可选画幅前缀，自带尾部空格；不用则空字符串

inputs.name: persona
examples: platinum pale-blonde hair with a light airy fringe, pale irises, fair skin, soft refined makeup, a quiet poised expression, gold star hair ornaments with pearl chains, wearing a soft light knit sweater

descriptions.en: Identity impressions to preserve from the reference person: hair color and style, fringe, gaze, expression, makeup, accessories, and clothing impression in one phrase
descriptions.zh-CN: 参考人物需保持的印象一句：发色发型、刘海、眼神、神情、妆容、饰品与服装印象

descriptions.en: Signature rendered character-exact near the campaign line, including every bracket and symbol; this is the replacement for the 「【在此输入签名】」 placeholder
descriptions.zh-CN: 宣传语附近逐字精确渲染的签名，含全部括号与符号；即 「【在此输入签名】」 占位符的替换值

descriptions.en: Short campaign line rendered verbatim in the lower left; Japanese or English, written from the subject visual impression; not a poem, not boilerplate
descriptions.zh-CN: 左下方逐字渲染的宣传语；日语或英语，按人物视觉印象创作，不是诗句、不要空泛套话
